CF-D root-cause (2026-07-12): NOT the RegControl/LDC family (mislabeled). The CIM deck differs from the byte-similar Test/IEEE13_Assets.dss (solvable_now, feeder) ONLY by `set earthmodel=carson` + a trailing `uuids/export cim100`. So the step-0 entry-6 node-V divergence (|diff|=1.008e-3, rel ~4.18e-7 at the 2.4 kV feeder-end nodes) is the Carson earth-model line-constant libm floor (real ln/arctan2 last-bit, MEMORY line-impedance-1ulp note) accumulated through the feeder, PLUS a short connector line (Length=0.0568) adding conditioning. Above the `large` v_rel (1e-7) by ~4x but below `large_near_ideal_source` v_rel (5e-6); no existing band fits and a bespoke ~5e-7 band is not yet justified, so it stays documented here (floating_zeroseq_bus precedent). The regulators land identical taps and RG60/650 match ~4e-6 (RegControl exonerated).

BLOCKED_PENDING UPGRADE (CF-B item 8d, T-A #11). Convergence is r4133-ONLY: the pinned 0.14.5 oracle does NOT converge (NO, 100 iters, persists across retries), r3723 also does NOT (NO, 100), and Rust does NOT (NO, 100) -- only the newer r4133 line converges (YES, 2 iters), an upstream solver change. No pinned-oracle compare possible and Rust must also solve; migratable only once the r4133 solver behavior is adopted (UPGRADE).

ROOT-CAUSED 2026-07-10 (user-directed deck audit): the deck data itself is pathological, no engine solves it as vendored. The 480 V DER microgrid island (m2001der480-2 delta secondary of a 750 kVA xfmr) is operated at the edge of voltage collapse, and Storage.battery1 (state=charging) / battery2 (idling) tip the snapshot power flow over the fixed-point stability boundary: |V| at M2001-ESS1 grows geometrically (~x2000/iteration; 6.97e4 -> 6.35e6 -> 1.26e10 V...) until NaN. Bisected: both batteries disabled -> converges (121 iterations -- still extremely marginal vs the usual 5-15); battery1=discharging -> converges (130); charging or idling -> geometric divergence. Engine-lineage-consistent: pinned oracle, official EPRI r3723/r4088/r4133, and the Rust port all diverge identically on the vendored deck, and on the healed variant (storages disabled) Rust converges in EXACTLY the oracle's 121 iterations. Deck/scenario bug (DERs likely meant to be coordinated/disabled by a separate scenario file), nothing to fix port-side. The earlier 'no JSON response' was a secondary serialization glitch of the NaN state.

CF-D root-cause (2026-07-12): PROVEN cross-solver conditioning floor, NOT the RegControl/LDC/transformer bug the label claimed. cond(assembled Y) = 9.79e11 -- driven by two linecode-BUSBAR (r1=x1=1e-4 ohm/km, units=km) ultra-switch lines in series with the 46 kV source: Line.MDV_SUB_1_HSB (source->SubXfmr HV) at length=0.001 units=m = 1e-6 km -> ~1e-10 ohm -> Y~1e10 S (this one drives the ill-conditioning), and Line.SSswitch (feederhead->BusPrim1) at length=1 units=m = 1e-3 km -> ~1e-7 ohm -> Y~1e7 S. The step-0 entry-0 node-V |diff|=5.53e-1 (rel 2.08e-5) at BUSSOURCE/MDV_SUB_1_HSB is solver junk in the ill-conditioned direction. Decomposition (scratchpad probes): assembled Y BIT-IDENTICAL between engines (all 570 entries max|dY|=0); Vsource injection Yprim*E BIT-IDENTICAL; load base kW/kvar identical to 7 figs; on the equivalent linear system the three solvers spread comparably -- faer(Rust) vs KLU(oracle) 0.758 V, faer vs scipy(equilibrated) 0.555 V, KLU vs scipy 0.776 V -- with residual parity ||Y*V_rust-inj||inf=4.40e-2 vs ||Y*V_oracle-inj||inf=4.56e-2 (neither engine is more correct). The regulator lands the identical tap and the regulated bus matches ~1e-6 (RegControl+SubXfmr exonerated; the 0.55 V gap is IDENTICAL with the regulator disabled and tap fixed). A ~1 V v_abs band would be needed to admit it (~4e-5 rel at the 46 kV buses); too wide to band honestly without masking real substation-transformer bugs, so it stays documented here (floating_zeroseq_bus precedent). Full proof: tests/TOLERANCE_NOTES.md, STATUS.md CF-D record.
